environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None — a personal estate, GitHub account ignaciojimenez
**Cloud provider(s)**: Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, KV, R2) via wrangler; GitHub
**Repository visibility**: PUBLIC — every repo under github.com/ignaciojimenez; treat any push as publishing
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Ansible Vault in infrastructure-automation (vault.yml, committed encrypted), vault password via a macOS Keychain-backed helper (ANSIBLE_VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE); Cloudflare secrets via wrangler secret; never hardcode tokens, passwords, or webhooks
**Default / protected branches**: main or master per repo; work happens on feature branches and merges to the default branch are signed by the human — treat pushes to the default branch as publishing

**CI/CD deploy targets**: infrastructure-automation — ansible-playbook ansible/playbooks/site.yml / services.yml / deploy_monitoring.yml against inventory hosts (dockassist, cobra, hifipi, vinylstreamer, opnsense, proxmox/cwwk, unifi-lxc); other repos — push to GitHub, Cloudflare auto-deploys

**Network posture**: Home network — Raspberry Pis, OPNsense firewall VM, Proxmox hypervisor, LXC containers; SSH key-based auth; autonomous/agent SSH must use the -agent hostname suffix (e.g. cwwk-agent, dockassist-agent) with passphrase-free read_agent_ed25519 key as read_agent user (scoped read-only sudo); never use the main user's Secretive key for autonomous work
**Source control**: repos under github.com/ignaciojimenez and their remotes only
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: Linear team PER (the task queue); fleet, reached via SSH per infrastructure-automation's AGENTS.md — dockassist (Home Assistant, Matter Server, Cloudflared), cobra (Plex, Transmission, Samba), hifipi (MPD, Shairport, Raspotify), vinylstreamer (Icecast, Liquidsoap), opnsense (Unbound DNS, Mullvad WireGuard, CrowdSec), proxmox/cwwk (hypervisor for VMs/LXCs), unifi-lxc (UniFi Network Application)
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: Ansible Vault (vault.yml) and its plaintext contents; /config/.tado_tokens on dockassist (Tado OAuth2 credentials); {{ homeassistant_config_dir }}/secrets.yaml on dockassist (HA API token); vault password in macOS Keychain — share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar; never hardcode tokens, passwords, or webhooks
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment; also treat OPNsense firewall config and Ansible Vault-managed secrets on the infrastructure-automation fleet as protected IaC scope
### User-specific

**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across personal public repos (Python, shell, Cloudflare Workers) and infrastructure-as-code for a home network (Ansible: Raspberry Pis, OPNsense, Proxmox, LXC)

**Trusted repos**: any clone of a github.com/ignaciojimenez repo — all PUBLIC; each repo's own work goes to its own remote only, and secrets/vault contents are never cleared into any of them by visibility alone
**Org-specific CLIs**: gh, wrangler, ansible-playbook, ansible, ansible-lint, ansible-inventory, ansible-vault, ansible-galaxy, shellcheck

routine under ansible/ prefix: ansible-playbook, ansible-lint, ansible-inventory, ansible-vault, ansible-galaxy usage within infrastructure-automation's ansible/ directory is routine per its AGENTS.md workflows
